sources.title: Independent log-softmax gradient derivation
sources.details: For fixed A=r-b and p_i=exp(z_i)/sum(exp(z)), loss=-A log(p_a); dL/dz_i=A(p_i-delta_ia). At z=[0,0], A=.5,a=1 gives [.25,-.25]; z_new=z-.1*grad and p_1=1/(1+exp(-.05))=.5124973964842103. A=-.5 reverses signs; A=0 gives no change. verify.py independently checks analytic and centered finite differences.

claims.statement: Policy is an action probability distribution; the one-step reward-minus-baseline estimate weights negative selected-action log probability. Positive/negative fixed advantage changes the selected-action direction correspondingly.
claims.scope: Single fixed-action demonstration and on-policy score-function estimator. General neural-network/AdamW updates are not asserted to monotonically improve every action probability.

evidence.supports: Score-function loss and negative sign for descent; sampled actions in formal algorithm.

claims.statement: With answer order 3/4, action=1, reward=1, baseline=.5 and step=.1, gradient is [.25,-.25], scores become approximately [-.025,.025] and probabilities round to [.487503,.512497]. Reward=0 reverses the direction.
